list.title: How to Use 10% Magnesium Lotion?
list.content:
To see a noticeable difference in your skin, it is recommended that you use the lotion regularly and consistently for 3-4 months.

Patch tests are an easy way to make sure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps:
1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow
2. Keep the area dry
3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product)
4. If any redness, itching or irritation is observed at any time during the test do not use the product, else you can safely use it

Step 1
Take 3-4 pumps of the product in your palms.
Step 2
Disperse product across feet, soles, legs, arms, neck, shoulder and massage it in for a few seconds for full absorption.
Step 3
Reapply for a quick recovery!
